items.text:
The fight against cancer is personal for my family—and while this is great news, there is still so much work to be done.

We must continue to invest in research and expand resources & support for patients and families fighting this devastating disease.
https://t.co/rW3Au6RTTM

Proud to stand with my brothers and sisters in labor from @UAW Local 1097 and across the U.S. as they exercise their right to strike and pursue a fair contract.

I hope both sides continue to negotiate in good faith and come to a resolution that supports working families. https://t.co/yvfHqlGFkP

US Air Force Major Select Terrell K. Brayman of Pittsford lost his life in a training exercise last month.

He would've celebrated his 33rd birthday next week.

Today, I spoke on the House floor in honor of his profound sense of duty, patriotism, and dedication to our country. https://t.co/mTlnqqehAY

Millions of families rely on the WIC program to put food on the table every day. 

I'm fighting to fully fund vital nutrition programs like this and ease the burden on struggling families—because no child should go hungry. https://t.co/1oAz22lI0Q

Glad to meet with Dr. Yurcheshen from @UR_Med and other members of the @AASMorg to discuss the importance of telehealth and overall sleep health.

I can promise you, this meeting wasn't a snooze! Thank you for stopping by. https://t.co/tgc0w9f4Ak

.@RepWexton's tenacity in the face of her diagnosis is inspirational, and her continued commitment to serving her community reflects her steadfast leadership.

Proud to call her a colleague and friend, and to support her during this #PSPAwarenessWeek.

Millions of families—including my own—know the heartache of receiving a cancer diagnosis. We owe it to them to do everything we can to put an end to this devastating disease.

That's what @CDC_Cancer is working towards every day, and I'm proud to partner with them. https://t.co/lcTbc4uN4Q

ROCovery Fitness is on a mission to support recovery and sober living through exercise, building community, acceptance, and understanding.

It was great to visit @ROCoveryfitness's facilities today to hear more about how we can work together to stop the cycle of addiction. https://t.co/KuC8gh0wSN

.@CityRochesterNY has declared a Cool Sweep today in anticipation of high temperatures.

Extreme heat can be especially dangerous for children and pets—please exercise caution and stay safe. https://t.co/gDqmO6W3Ht

Finally, @HouseAppropsGOP have taken aim at rural development, agricultural, and food service programs, including WIC, SNAP, child nutrition programs, @US_FDA, rural housing, farming assistance, and more.

It was great to stop by the Southwest Area Neighborhood Association's community cookout today!

SWAN is a community leader providing essential education, youth development, economic, and nutrition resources for families in the southwest quadrant of Rochester. https://t.co/kBCMSXJc1L

Proud to stand with @CountyExecBello to deliver @fema funds for backup generators for Monroe County's wastewater treatment facility.
 
These generators will allow us to continue processing wastewater in a power outage—protecting our environment and our neighborhoods. https://t.co/4qaUo6Jeii

Extremist Republicans are working overtime to limit women's reproductive healthcare. I'm fighting to make it more accessible, from contraception and abortion coverage to IVF and infertility treatment.

Everyone deserves the opportunity to grow their family on their own terms.

I'm co-sponsoring The Access to Infertility Treatment and Care Act to require health insurance plans to provide coverage for treatment of infertility without raising insurance or copayment costs.

Read More: https://t.co/AuKXFA1IGu

Today is #WorldAlzheimersDay.

This devastating disease affects over 5 million Americans. We must support them by investing in research and resources to reduce risk, detect early symptoms, and improve the quality of life for our loved ones as they age. https://t.co/x7mTe5ICga

October is #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth—a time to come together in support of those fighting cancer.

For me and my family, the fight against breast cancer is personal. I'm committed to making screening, prevention, and treatment services accessible for those who need it most. https://t.co/u3ovWMs2ur

40% of students were aware of a deepfake of someone associated with their school last year.

Our laws must meet the evolving threats of AI. My legislation would establish criminal and civil penalties for producing deepfakes and create a strong deterrent.
https://t.co/bWwXR7rFoj

Today is #WorldCancerDay. For me and for so many others, it's deeply personal.

As we recommit to prevention, early detection, and treatment efforts, let us also be bold. Let us be brave. Let us dare to believe that we can cure cancer—and then let us get to work. https://t.co/kbwQ4YBRBt

Access to education and supportive resources can make a real difference both before and after a triple-negative breast cancer diagnosis. 

I'm proud to sponsor legislation to increase access to life-saving information and treatments as we work toward a future free from this devastating disease.

The @AlzRochesterNY does incredible work to support people living with Alzheimer's and their families.

It was an honor to welcome members of their organization to my office today and discuss our continued commitment to advancing Alzheimer's research and treatment. https://t.co/Vb4lcBlV8j

After years of work, it's official: @WilmotCancer has been designated as a National Cancer Institute!

This prestigious recognition firmly establishes Wilmot among the nation’s premier cancer research and treatment centers, ensuring they remain a beacon of hope for families facing cancer for generations to come.
The SAVE Act would leave Americans drowning in expensive paperwork just to exercise their fundamental right to vote. https://t.co/mQDwrfVve2

How does deporting a four-year-old undergoing treatment for metastatic cancer make America any safer? How does deporting a two-year-old reduce crime? It doesn’t. It’s just cruel.

Instead of using Rochester as a prop to make a political statement, Tom Homan should focus on following the rule of law and actually doing his job.

It's #FentanylAwarenessDay, but our community organizations are fighting the opioid epidemic every day.

We need to fight for the programs that prevent overdoses, deliver treatment, and offer hope—and we can't allow the Trump administration to continue gutting their funding.

Earlier this month, we stood with Delphi Rise, our area's only 24-hour addiction treatment center, to speak out against thoughtless cuts by the Trump administration.

I proudly joined @CountyExecBello to announce emergency funding that kept their doors open, and I'll keep fighting to support these critical facilities because no one facing addiction should be left alone in their darkest moments.
